units.source_text: 正月十八日的竞射和二十一日的内宴过去之后，匂亲王悠闲无事。

en.t: After the archery contest on the eighteenth day of the first month and the palace banquet on the twenty-first had passed, Prince Niou had nothing to do and was at leisure.

units.source_text: 地方官任免之期，人皆尽力钻营，却与匂亲王无关，他所考虑的只是如何可以秘密赴宇治一行。

en.t: It was the season for appointing and dismissing provincial officials, and everyone was busily seeking advantage, but none of that concerned Prince Niou; all he thought about was how he might secretly make a trip to Uji.

units.source_text: 这大内记盼望升官，不分昼夜地讨好匂亲王。

en.t: This Senior Secretary hoped for promotion and tried day and night to ingratiate himself with Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王也比往日更亲切地使唤他。

en.t: Prince Niou, for his part, used his services more warmly than before.

units.source_text: 他对大内记说：“无论何等困难的事，你能照我所说的办到么？”

en.t: He said to the Senior Secretary, "No matter how difficult a thing may be, could you do it exactly as I tell you?"

units.source_text: 大内记恭恭敬敬地遵命。

en.t: The Senior Secretary respectfully accepted the command.

units.source_text: 匂亲王又说：“这话说出来不好意思。不瞒你说：我和住在宇治的那个女子，以前曾有一面之缘。

en.t: Prince Niou went on, "This is embarrassing to say. To be honest with you, I once had a brief acquaintance with the woman living in Uji.

units.source_text: 后来此人行向不明，听说是右大将把她寻找出来藏在那边的。

en.t: Afterward her whereabouts became unknown, and I hear that the Right General found her and hid her there.

units.source_text: 是否确实如此，不得而知。

en.t: Whether that is truly so, I cannot know.

units.source_text: 我只希望从隙缝中窥探一下，到底是否我所见过的那个人。

en.t: I only want to peep through a crack and see whether she is in fact the person I once saw.

units.source_text: 但须十分秘密，绝不叫人知道，你有什么办法？”

en.t: But it must be kept completely secret, and no one must find out. Do you have any way to manage it?"

units.source_text: 大内记一想：此事困难。但他答道：“到宇治去，山路十分崎岖。

en.t: The Senior Secretary thought to himself that the matter would be difficult, but he answered, "The mountain road to Uji is very rough.

units.source_text: 然而里程并不很远，傍晚出发，亥子时间即可到达。

en.t: Still, the distance is not very great; if we leave in the evening, we can arrive around the hours of the Boar and the Rat.

units.source_text: 然后于破晓动身返京。

en.t: Then we can set out at daybreak and return to the capital.

units.source_text: 如此，除了随从人员之外，不会有人知道。

en.t: In that way, no one except the attendants will know.

units.source_text: 不过那边细情如何，不得而知了。”

en.t: However, I cannot know what the exact circumstances are over there."

units.source_text: 匂亲王说：“你说的是。这条路我以前也曾走过一两次。

en.t: Prince Niou said, "You are right. I have traveled that road once or twice before.

units.source_text: 我所顾虑的不在道路，倒在于外间非议，怕有人讥评我行动轻率。”

en.t: What worries me is not the road, but public criticism; I fear people will mock my behavior as reckless."

units.source_text: 他自己心中虽然也反复考虑，认为万不可行，但一经说出，就欲罢不能。

en.t: Although he himself thought it over again and again and felt that he absolutely must not go, once he had spoken of it, he could no longer stop.

units.source_text: 于是选定随从人员：以前曾经陪他去过而熟悉那边情况的二三人，这大内记，还有一个青年人，是他的乳母的儿子，

en.t: So he chose his attendants: two or three men who had accompanied him there before and knew the situation, this Senior Secretary, and a young man who was the son of his nurse,

units.source_text: 本来是六位藏人而现已升为五位的，这些都是他的亲信。

en.t: who had originally been a sixth-rank chamberlain and had now risen to the fifth rank; all of them were his trusted men.

units.source_text: 又叫大内记去打听清楚：薰大将今明两日之内是不会赴宇治去的。

en.t: He also had the Senior Secretary make certain that General Kaoru would not be going to Uji today or tomorrow.

units.source_text: 到了出发的时候，他回想起从前的情形：从前薰大将和他异常亲睦，曾经引导他到宇治去。

en.t: When the time came to depart, he recalled the past: General Kaoru had once been exceptionally close to him and had even guided him to Uji.

units.source_text: 今日此行，实在对他不起。他就回想起种种事情来。

en.t: This journey today was truly a betrayal of him, and Prince Niou found himself remembering all sorts of things.

units.source_text: 然而不管如何，这位在京中也不敢微服出门的贵人，今天竟也穿上了粗布衣服。

en.t: Yet whatever the case, this nobleman, who would not dare go out in disguise even in the capital, actually put on coarse clothing today.

units.source_text: 他想起骑马觉得可怕，认为是痛苦之事。

en.t: When he thought of riding a horse, he found it frightening and considered it a painful ordeal.

units.source_text: 但今日色胆包天，毅然入山，越走越深，一路上只是想：“快点到吧！

en.t: But today desire made him bold beyond measure; he resolutely entered the mountains, went deeper and deeper, and thought only, "Let us arrive quickly!

units.source_text: 不知此行究竟如何？如果不能看到此女而空手归来，多么扫兴，

en.t: I wonder how this journey will turn out. If I cannot see the woman and come back empty-handed, how disappointing it will be;

units.source_text: 那真是荒唐之行了。”他心头跳个不住。

en.t: it would truly have been an absurd expedition." His heart kept pounding without pause.

units.source_text: 从京中到法性寺是乘车的，以后乘马。

en.t: From the capital to Hosshoji he traveled by carriage, and after that he rode on horseback.
